messages:
nightly-bot: nightly-evals alert: prompt-bundle v7 pushed to canary produced +6.2% failure rate on pset-42 compared to baseline. top delta: anchor-precision down 0.18, rerank recall down 0.12. see summary: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/ev/2501234567
Maya Chen: ugh, I landed the v7 splice last night to remove ambiguous separator tokens. noticed whitespace normalization in the preproc change. guessing whitespace collapse caused prompt +few tokens to mash?
Aj Patel: can you paste the diff?
Maya Chen: quick diff below:
```diff
-User: "List the steps.\n1) Install\n2) Configure\n3) Run"
+User: "List the steps. 1) Install 2) Configure 3) Run"
```
Maya Chen: we removed newlines to standardize examples, hoping to reduce token variance. appears to have made anchor contexts less distinct.
Leo Ramos: sample failing case from nightly run (model: rdmx-1.3q):
PROMPT: "Summarize: List the steps. 1) Install 2) Configure 3) Run"
EXPECTED: bullet list with 3 items
ACTUAL: single-line paraphrase merged into one sentence -> causes reranker to miss anchors.
Rachel G.: metric breakdown from the job: pset-42 overall exact-match went 0.67 -> 0.59, anchor-precision 0.81 -> 0.63. most regressions in examples with numbered lists and line breaks.
Samir K.: can we run a targeted canary reverting only whitespace normalization on 1000 examples? I can spin up a quick canary job.
Aj Patel: +1 do that. also add a small prompt patch that escapes newlines explicitly (e.g., `\\n`) in the canonical examples and run both variants.
Maya Chen: putting together canary commands now. will run: 1) v7 with revert on preprocessing, 2) v7 + explicit `\\n` in prompts. sending results in ~45m.
nightly-bot: job queued: eval/canary/2501234567-1 (revert-preproc), eval/canary/2501234567-2 (escape-newlines). ETA ~40m.
Leo Ramos: small note: this likely affects caching/prefix matching too — cache keys include canonicalized prompt text. collapsing whitespace may make different cases hit the same cache but confuse reranker. track cache hit rate in canary.
Rachel G.: also add a few manual checks for downstream QA: try pset-42 where answers are multiline code blocks. those are flipping.
Samir K.: ack. will add cache/hits and attach failing sample IDs.
Aj Patel: if canary confirms revert fixes >90% of delta, we'll revert v7 and open a follow-up PR to add an explicit newline-preservation rule instead of blind collapse.
Maya Chen: got it. will post results + sample diffs when done. thanks all :thumbsup:
